scientific_integrity: Finite sector values proved by two independent exhaustive integer enumerations and a rational lower-envelope argument. The independent-set polynomial gives a separate saturation identity. Literature checks are limited to identified public records and examined source text.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite, zero-temperature classification for the specified 16-site five-regular Clebsch graph and three named spin colors only; no finite-temperature, thermodynamic or generic-graph claims. Historical novelty provisional, since unindexed graph-specific tables may exist.
title: Exact five-threshold field diagram of the three-state Clebsch Potts antiferromagnet
